int read() {
    int x = 0, f = 1;
    char ch = getchar();
    while(ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if(ch == '-') f = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while(ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + (ch ^ 48);
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return x * f;
}

void write(int x) {
    if(x < 0) {
        putchar('-');
        x = -x;
    }
    if(x > 9) write(x / 10);
    putchar(x % 10 + '0');
}

void writeln(int x) {
    write(x);
    putchar('\n');
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {

int lcm(int a, int b) {
